scope: Read-only pre-start recheck; no modifications to the Job.

files.status-tool.json: Job and pod state from the status API.
files.results-listing.json: S3 object listing for the exact Job prefix.
files.container.log: Bounded log payload from the log API.
files.DATA_INDEX.json: Indexed evidence inventory with hashes, sizes, and roles.
files.manifest.sha256: SHA-256 inventory for evidence and description files.

interpretation: Pending and empty logs mean no producer output was observed at capture time; they do not establish the Job's terminal outcome.
